transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, doctor. I'm coming in today because I've been feeling extremely down, sad, and completely empty inside for the past four months. It feels like this dark cloud just won't lift, and I really don't know what to do.

During these past few months or at any other time in your life, have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or impulsive, to the point where you didn't need much sleep?

Yes, actually, before this depression hit I had a period of about 11 months where I felt completely overflowing with energy and just couldn't stop talking. I barely slept at all, sometimes staying up for nights on end, but I never felt tired and just felt this constant drive to keep going.
During those periods of high energy, did you ever experience things that others couldn't see or hear, or hold beliefs that seemed unusual or impossible to those around you?
No, I never saw or heard things that weren't there, and I didn't hold any unusual beliefs. I just felt incredibly energetic, talked constantly, and felt like I didn't need to sleep at all.

During that high-energy period, did your behavior or the lack of sleep cause significant problems in your daily life, such as getting you fired from your job, requiring a hospital stay, or leading to serious legal or financial trouble?

No, I don't think it ever reached the point of needing a hospital stay or causing legal trouble, though it was a very intense period for me. I just kept pushing through all that energy, even if it was a bit chaotic.
